verdict.rationale: Maritime documents a first-party Computers product: a persistent Linux desktop (XFCE, Chromium, LibreOffice) per end user that a model can drive through screenshots, mouse and keyboard, with a live view you can take over. That delivers the full-desktop half of the story directly. missing for 10: explicit documentation of the desktop's sandbox isolation boundary, an explicit headless-browser mode inside agent containers, and independent or hands-on corroboration (the changelog's 'are getting' wording suggests a recent or rolling release).

support.subject: As a developer, I can run a headless browser or full desktop environment inside the sandbox

citations.quote: A persistent Linux desktop (XFCE, Chromium, LibreOffice) for each of _your_ end users, driven by _your_ model.
Agents are getting a real Linux desktop they can drive: screenshot, mouse, keyboard, and a live view you can take over.
To hand out a key that reaches computers and nothing else, create a **Computers key** in the Computers section of Settings, API keys
